fullDescription:
Exude high-fashion editorial chic, fluid swash elegance, and modern luxury with Elovia! Designed as a modern ligature serif font, it features dramatic looping ligatures, starry diamond accents, and sleek high-contrast stems. Its graceful curves and seamless character flow make logos, titles, and headers look effortlessly high-end and bespoke.

Ideal for luxury fashion logotypes, boutique branding, beauty packaging, editorial magazine titles, wedding invitation suites, quote prints, and custom Cricut or Silhouette craft SVG projects!
